judge: usage-judge (two independent model passes, keys withheld, per-pass option shuffle)
note: TASK-179 N4 用法 batch. Candidates were offered with options shuffled independently per pass so position never leaks the key, and a row is kept only when every judge pass returns PASS and each pick is that pass's frozen key slot. Pass 1 was run twice by two separate judge agents and pass 2 once; the survivor set is identical under both readings (19 rows), which is the value of the intersection rather than a single agreement. AMBIGUOUS means two of the four forms both complete the sentence, which a 用法 小問 cannot carry: 用法 asks which form the sentence REQUIRES, and 後で/から or やすい/にくい pairs where nothing in the sentence fixes the direction are not items.
